text: Steven, a heart surgeon in Cincinnati, meets a sixteen-year-old named Martin in a diner and brings him home to his wife and children. Martin's father died on Steven's operating table, and Steven has hidden [the drink he took before that operation|wrong|failing to protect]. Now Martin calmly demands [a life from Steven's own family|ending|killing someone close]. Until Steven chooses, [his children lose the use of their legs|images|wounded and changing bodies], refuse food and will bleed from the eyes, and [no test or doctor can halt it|rules|nothing can stop it].
